headline: Sensex rallies 773 points, Nifty closes above 25,250 driven by foreign inflows and PSU bank gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign institutional investors returned to Indian stocks, pushing markets to an eight-month high.
PSU Banking stocks surged up to 3%, leading sector-wise gains across the broad market.
Massive early buying momentum added approximately ₹4.5 lakh crore in investor wealth.
Strong performance in auto and aviation heavyweights like M&M and IndiGo further boosted market sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 773 points while Nifty 50 finished comfortably above 25,250.
Mutual fund inflows touched ₹1.73 lakh crore in October, despite equity inflows declining 14% over September.
ValueQuest committed ₹775 crore to three Indian manufacturing and defence firms.
Power ministry requested extending LPS Rules benefit to energy storage companies.
summary:
Indian equities logged sharp gains on November 11 as Sensex jumped 773 points and Nifty crossed 25,250, supported by foreign investor inflows and a 3% surge in PSU banks.
Top gainers included Mahindra & Mahindra and IndiGo, while Garden Reach Shipbuilders posted a 12% rise in quarterly net profit.
Additionally, domestic mutual fund inflows remained strong at ₹1.73 lakh crore for the month of October.
